XMLDB.COMMENT: NIT AI video assistant: one approved transcript per course module, the quiz generation runs written from it, and the videos being transcribed into one.

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_ai_transcripts
TABLE.COMMENT: One transcript per course module. Keyed on cmid, NOT on a video provider, so any activity that can show a video can carry one.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module the transcript belongs to

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning module, e.g. mod_vdocipher. Picks the player adapter.

FIELD.NAME: sourceref
FIELD.COMMENT: Provider video id at approval time. A change means the video was replaced.

FIELD.NAME: sourcelength
FIELD.COMMENT: Video duration in seconds at approval time

FIELD.NAME: format
FIELD.COMMENT: Detected source format: vtt|srt|json|txt

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Detected language: ar|en|mixed|unknown

FIELD.NAME: hasonscreen
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher says the transcript includes on-screen text (code, slides)

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the teacher wants the transcript from: auto (written from the video) or file (uploaded)

FIELD.NAME: lasttimestamp
FIELD.COMMENT: Last cue start in seconds; compared against sourcelength

FIELD.NAME: segments
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of {s,e,t} cues

FIELD.NAME: plaintext
FIELD.COMMENT: Flattened text, used when there are no timestamps

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher ticked 'enable the assistant'

FIELD.NAME: approved
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher reviewed the parse result and approved it

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who uploaded the transcript; they own keeping it up to date

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_ai_quizgen
TABLE.COMMENT: One quiz generation run per attempt. Holds the draft questions between generating them and creating the quiz, and stays afterwards as the link between a quiz and the video it was written from.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module of the video the questions were written from

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who ran the generator

FIELD.NAME: sourceref
FIELD.COMMENT: Provider video id at generation time. A change means the quiz describes a video nobody is watching.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft while the teacher is reviewing, created once the quiz exists

FIELD.NAME: options
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the choices made in the wizard

FIELD.NAME: items
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON holding the generated questions and the blocks declared empty of teachable content

FIELD.NAME: coverage
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: which parts of the video the questions reach, and which they miss

FIELD.NAME: quizcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module of the quiz this run created, 0 while still a draft

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_ai_stt
TABLE.COMMENT: A lesson video being turned into a transcript by our own Whisper service. One row per course module; the video itself is never kept.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module the transcript is for

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who uploaded the video; told when the transcript is ready

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the uploaded video; the transcript is named after it

FIELD.NAME: enable
FIELD.COMMENT: Switch the assistant on when the transcript arrives, if no earlier transcript decided it

FIELD.NAME: uploadid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_nit_ai_uploads row holding the video when it came through our chunked upload; 0 when it is in the media file area

FIELD.NAME: jobid
FIELD.COMMENT: Job id on the service, empty until it has the video

FIELD.NAME: progress
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent transcribed while running

FIELD.NAME: position
FIELD.COMMENT: Place in the service queue while queued

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Why it failed, or why sending it is being retried

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_ai_uploads
TABLE.COMMENT: A lesson video uploaded in chunks to this server, on its way to VdoCipher and to the transcription service. The file is deleted once both have it.

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Random handle the browser uploads against and the form submits

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who is uploading; only they may add to it or claim it

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Set when the activity form is saved; 0 until then

FIELD.NAME: filesize
FIELD.COMMENT: Bytes the browser said it would send

FIELD.NAME: received
FIELD.COMMENT: Bytes written so far; the next chunk must start here

FIELD.NAME: videoid
FIELD.COMMENT: VdoCipher video id, known as soon as the upload completes

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the VdoCipher S3 form, until the file has been pushed

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Why pushing to VdoCipher failed or is being retried
